question: What specific object or mark situated at the forehead must be offered or recognized when acting in the presence of the god-worshipped one after completing the prescribed act?
premises: A mark situated in the forehead-syllable mass is to be identified here.
A hundred-thousand measure is linked to that mark in this context.
The act is completed prior to directing attention to the god-worshipped recipient.
inference: After completing the prescribed act, one directs attention to the hundred-thousand mark situated in the forehead-syllable mass in relation to the god-worshipped one.
